title: Misogynistic Move – Bring Back International Women's Day
body: Apple removing International Women’s Day from the calendar is a disgrace. This isn’t just an oversight—it’s a deliberate erasure of a day that recognises half the world’s population. Women are a massive part of Apple’s customer base (around 51% of iPhone users), yet this move shows nothing but disrespect. It’s pathetic and completely unnecessary. If Apple wants to keep profiting off women, the least it can do is acknowledge them. Fix this.

title: Kalenderen er et dejligt redskab.
body:
Jeg bruger altid kalenderen og vi bruger den synkroniseret i familien generelt. 
Jeg kunne godt ønske mig at der var mulighed for at give de forskellige medlemmer en bestemt farve i bl.a.  en fælles familiekalender, så man kan se hvem det omhandler. 
Mere endnu ønsker jeg mig at den bliver mere åben for adresser. Jeg oplever ofte at kalenderen ikke vil ‘godkende’ en adresse og derved ikke beregne rejsetid eller åbne gps. 
Ellers er vi glade for kalenderen.

title: Basic and lack of cooperating features
body:
For a basic calendar experience, this app is fine. 
However, it stands isolated within the apple eco-system, and is unable to interact with the reminders app, apple notes, apple shortcuts or similar products.
